evidence.title: Projection Direction is Scratch -> NGVGE
evidence.detail: Authority Registry and Scratch projection contract agree on Scratch -> NGVGE direction.

evidence.title: Transform2D uses stable NodeId
evidence.detail: Runtime/Persistent Transform ownership is keyed by stable semantic NodeId, not target.id.

evidence.title: Scratch Target does not enter component records
evidence.detail: Transform component and exported persistent Runtime Node state contain no Scratch Target identity/object.

evidence.title: Editor mutation is expressible as PatchComponent
evidence.detail: Editor Transform intent is a portable PatchComponent Engine Command DTO.

evidence.title: Persistent DTO passes serialization gate
evidence.detail: Transform component data and exported Runtime Node persistent state pass Persistent DTO validation.

evidence.title: Scratch Adapter Boundary remains enforceable
evidence.detail: Scratch representation remains confined to Compatibility Adapter; semantic Transform ownership stays NodeId-based.

evidence.title: No Scratch Renderer private objects enter Transform layers
evidence.detail: Static boundary scan finds no Scratch renderer-private representation in Transform semantic/runtime/projection layers.

evidence.title: Future Authority reversal retains a one-way projection seam
evidence.detail: Current projection is one-way and the Editor command executor remains a replaceable Authority bridge seam.

evidence.title: Runtime Transform is separated from Persistent Transform
evidence.detail: 240 runtime projections diverge Runtime Transform from Persistent Transform without mutating component data.

evidence.title: High-frequency Runtime updates do not frame-write project source
evidence.detail: 240 high-frequency projections perform zero project-source writes and leave persistent export byte-equivalent.
